container_path: Michigan Retinal Degeneration Questionnaire Reading Domain Scores (Questions 1 to 11) :

blocks.text:
0 = None; 1 = A little difficulty; 2 = Moderate difficulty; 3 = Extreme difficulty; 4 = My vision is too poor to do this; 5 = N/A for non-vision reasons.

Key 2: 0 = Never; 1 = Sometimes; 2 = Frequently; 3 = Always; 4 = Does not help; 5 = NA for non-vision reasons.

Q1: Reading books, magazines, or mail? [Key 1]

Q2: Reading on a computer or tablet? [Key 1]

Q3: Reading on cell phone screens? [Key 1]

Q4: Reading the newspaper, food labels, price tags, or medication labels? [Key 1]

Q5: Reading direction signs? [Key 1]

Q6: Reading store names? [Key 1]

Q7: Scan a page or line of text to find the "right spot" to read? [Key 2]

Q8: Adjust the amount of room light to read? [Key 2]

Q9: Mover closer to objects to read? [Key 2]

Q10: Use vision aids for close reading? [Key 2]

Q11: Use vision aids for distance reading? [Key 2]

blocks.text:
NEI-VFQ-25 = National Eye Institute Visual Function Questionnaire 25.

Key 1:
container_path:
NEI-VFQ-25 = National Eye Institute Visual Function Questionnaire 25.

Key 1:

blocks.text:
1 = 1 - Excellent; 2 = 2 - Very Good; 3 = 3 - Good; 4 = 4 - Fair; 5 = 5 - Poor.

Key 2: 1 = 1 - Excellent; 2 = 2 - Good; 3 = 3 - Fair; 4 = 4 - Poor 5 = 5 - Very Poor; 6 = 6 - Completely Blind.

Key 3: 1 = 1 - None of the time; 2 = 2 - A little of the time; 3 = 3 - Some of the time; 4 = 4 - Most of the time; 5 = 5 - All of the time.

Key 4: 1 = 1 - None; 2 = 2 - Mild; 3 = 3 - Moderate; 4 = 4 - Severe; 5 = 5 - Very Severe.

Key 5: 1 = 1 - No difficulty at all; 2 = 2 - A little difficulty; 3 = 3 - Moderate difficulty; 4 = 4 - Extreme difficulty;

5 = 5 - Stopped doing this because of your eyesight;

6 = 6 - Stopped doing this for other reasons or not interested in doing this.

Q1: In general, would you say your overall health is [Key 1]

Q2: At the present time, would you say your eyesight using both eyes (with glasses or contact lenses, if you wear them) is excellent, good, fair, poor, or very poor, or are you completely blind? [Key 2]

Q3: How often are you concerned about your eyesight? [Key 3]

Q4: How much pain or discomfort have you had in and around your eyes (for example, burning, itching, or aching) ? Would you say it is [Key 4]

Q5: How much difficulty do you have reading ordinary print in newspapers? Would you say you have [Key 5]

Q6: How much difficulty do you have doing work or hobbies that require you to see well up close, such as cooking, sewing, fixing things around the house, or using hand tools? Would you say you have [Key 5]

Q7: Because of your eyesight, how much difficulty do you have finding something on a crowded shelf? [Key 5]

Q8: Because of your eyesight, how much difficulty do you have reading street signs or the names of shops? [Key 5]

Q9: Because of your eyesight, how much difficulty do you have going down steps, stairs, or curbs in dim light or at night? [Key 5]

Q10: Because of your eyesight, how much difficulty do you have noticing objects on the side while you are walking along? [Key 5]

Q11: Because of your eyesight, how much difficulty do you have seeing how people react to things you say? [Key 5]

Q12: Because of your eyesight, how much difficulty do you have picking out and matching your own clothes? [Key 5]

Q13: Because of your eyesight, how much difficulty do you have visiting people in their homes, at parties, or in restaurants? [Key 5]

Q14: Because of your eyesight, how much difficulty do you have going out to see films, plays, or sports events? [Key 5]
